entries.description: Asks the session to call a procedure of its root module on a period. name is that procedure. seconds is the period. A second attach of the same name replaces the period. The session keeps the registration. A host asks the session to run what is due. The backend does not own a timer, so a host that never asks runs nothing.
entries.parameters:
name — a procedure of the session's root module.
seconds — the period, in seconds.

entries.description: Drops the idle registration of that name. A name that was not attached is left as it was.
entries.parameters: name — the procedure that was attached.
